files.description: The pattern its `files` has, from the content root.

folder.description:
The folder of the pages it covers, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is
in.

guide.description:
Its `guide`, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in, in the order to
read them: their guide, then Ascribe's notes on the type.

name.description: The type's name, `[types.<name>]`, which is the template's.

template.description: Its `template`, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in.

EjectAnswer.description:
What `ascribe templates eject` did: the files it wrote and the types it
added, or, when it refused anything, what it refused, and then it wrote
nothing.

added.description:
The types added to `ascribe.toml`, in the order they were named.
Empty when anything was refused.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

page_declared.description:
Whether `ascribe.toml` declared no types, so that every page was of
the implicit type `page`, and `[types.page]` was written out first,
as it was, so the pages outside the types added keep it.

refused.description:
What was refused, in the order it was named. When it isn't empty,
nothing was written.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

written.description:
The files written, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in,
`/`-separated, in the order they were written: each template, its
guide, and Ascribe's notes on its type, then `templates.lock`, then
`ascribe.toml`. Empty when anything was refused.

Refusal.description: A template eject refused, and why.

path.description:
The file in the way, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in, when that's
the reason; otherwise null.

oneOf.description: The set has no template of that name.
`ascribe.toml` declares a type of that name already.
A file is where one of its files would be written.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

content_root.description: The content root, from the new project's folder.

content_root_made.description:
Whether the content root was made: false when the folder was there
already, or nothing was written.

next.description: The page to read next: the Astro guide, by its permalink.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

templates.description:
What eject did, when the templates were asked for; otherwise null.
When its `refused` isn't empty, nothing was written.

written.description:
The files written, from the new project's folder, `/`-separated, in
the order they were written: with the templates, eject's files, then
`ascribe.toml`. Empty when the templates were refused.
